targets: all points of each toy curve, including infinity in the denominator
pairs: unordered distinct affine factor-base points; infinity sums excluded
field_basis: polynomial basis, certified irreducible fixed toy moduli
factor_base: all rational points with x in the specified F2 vector space
derived_bounds: on a curve defined over the proper subfield, points with both coordinates there remain there under addition
screening_success: For dimension k on at least three of the four full_degree_holdout curves, at least one structured family has lower product-span dimension and at least as many distinct nonidentity pair-sum targets as generic_linear. This is a structural screen, not a solver speedup.
rejection_rule: Do not promote a narrower product span alone. Retain empty bases, zero coverage and regressions. Do not extrapolate these toy counts to Oakley or to a subgroup DLP.
benchmark_exception: The frozen WDSat corpus measures a solver. This experiment exhaustively measures small-curve relation geometry and invokes no solver; its own matched synthetic inputs are frozen here. It is not an equivalent solver-performance benchmark.
